body:
Six leaks. One checklist for why lead ads fill your sheet but not your sales calendar.

Across 7,341 lead form submissions on nine Meta ad accounts, we kept tracing "bad leads" back to the same six spots. None of them are the ad.

Call it the Six Leaks. Save it before your next campaign, not after.

If you run your own ads, use this before you blame the creative or the audience again.

Free to check yourself: an audit of your lead flow, no charge, just tell me where you're stuck.

#leadgen #metaads #digitalmarketing

slides.text: Six leaks explain why lead ads never turn into buyers.
A lead can cost you 20 cents and still cost you a sale.
Leak one: the form asks for an email before it asks for intent.
Leak two: nobody replies inside the first hour a lead comes in.
Leak three: the same reply goes to a wholesale buyer and a browser.
Leak four: the ad promises one thing, the landing page shows another.
Leak five: WhatsApp opens the chat, then nobody's watching it after 6pm.
Leak six: nobody ever asks the lead why they clicked in the first place.
Fix these six and the same ad spend starts producing buyers, not just names.
The leak is rarely the ad. It's what happens in the ninety seconds after.
